predictions.quote: So, I expect uh that the pace of deportations will increase a little bit.
predictions.prediction: Vance predicts the pace of deportations under the Trump administration will increase somewhat going forward, citing new ICE resources from the 'big beautiful bill' and recent court wins.

predictions.quote: I think in 2025, we will have the first net negative immigration number in about 50 or 60 years in the United States.
predictions.prediction: Vance predicts the U.S. will record its first net negative immigration number in roughly 50 to 60 years for calendar year 2025.

predictions.quote: For every self-driving car we put on the road, that's four drivers who are going to have their jobs retired. They'll be displaced. For every Optimus robot or humanoid robot that eventually makes it into a factory, that'll be five or six factory jobs.
predictions.prediction: Each self-driving car deployed will displace roughly four driver jobs, and each humanoid/Optimus-style robot deployed in a factory will displace roughly five to six factory jobs.
